question: The major resources of Gondwana coal, which are metallurgical coal are located in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __Damodar valley__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Gondwana fields account for **99%** of all coal output and nearly all of** India's coal reserves**.
 
• Gondwana coal fields are a** source of bituminous coal, non-coking coal, and coking coal**.
 
• Although Gondwana coal is dry, contain **sulphur and deposits rarely contain anthracite.**
 
• The coalfields in **Lower Gondwana**, or the Damudar series, shared for **80% of India's total coal production.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Chambal Valley

 
 
• On the Chambal River, which is the** main and major tributary of the Yamuna**, Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh joint project launched the Chambal Valley Project in 1954.
 
• With this project, the Chambal River will be **used for irrigation, power production, and erosion management** in the valley.
 
• The first stage is building the **514-meter Gandhisagar dam**, which is **64 metres high**, about 8 km downstream from Chaurasigarh Fort in the M.P. district of Bhanupura.
 
 
 
• **Krishna Valley**
 
 
• Another Indian valley, the Krishna River, ranks as the **country's 4th largest river** in terms of water inputs.
 
• In India, it is the** third-largest river basin** after the Ganga and the Godavari.
 
• The river spans over **1,288 kilometres.**
 
• It also goes by the name **Krishnaveni.**
 
 
 
• **Narmada Valley**
 
 
• It is the state of Madhya Pradesh's **greatest flowing river. **
 
• India's Madhya Pradesh and Gujarat states are traversed by this river. 
 
• Due to its enormous contribution to the two states in numerous ways, it is also known as the **"Life Line of Madhya Pradesh and Gujarat".**
